title: Authority manifest
description: Stage 2 authority-manifest artifact (02-authority-manifest.json). Compiles every requirement from constitutions, sample evidence, lifecycle skills, and publication context with source locations, ownership, and conflict tracking.

language.description: One of the five supported sample languages.

requirements.description: All compiled requirements with source traceability.

authorityRank.description: Authority rank per the plan's review-authority order (1=base constitution, 6=existing article text).

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to the source file containing this requirement.

sourceRevision.description: Commit SHA or version of the source file.

locator.description: Heading, section, or line anchor within the source file.

requirementText.description: The verbatim or summarized requirement text.

ownership.description: Whether this requirement is owned by the technical layers or by the editorial gate.

category.description: Requirement category (e.g. authentication, configuration, lifecycle, safety).

appliesToLanguages.description: Languages this requirement applies to; empty array means all languages.

conflicts.description: Detected conflicts between requirements. Any blocking conflict stops the run.

blocking.description: All conflicts are blocking; they stop the run.
